create_glyph_cache_gl: create a GlyphCacheGL with R8_UNORM format, 128x128 size, and custom padding values
create_distance_field_glyph_cache: create a DistanceFieldGlyphCacheGL with 1024x1024 atlas size and 128x128 glyph size
